notes: v444 — 📱 Report cards readable on a phone. The 🧪 All-scans card was showing columns of percentages with nothing saying which scan or which pair they belonged to. The cause was an old mobile styling rule written for the share table that was matching EVERY table in the app and deleting the first column. It is now scoped properly, and on a narrow screen each row restacks: the scan or pair name on its own line, with the 5 / 10 / 20-day figures underneath it, each captioned. The report cards also now open large — on a desktop the 20-day column was being cut off at the default window size. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5), or on a phone pull down to refresh, to update.
